svg.title: Six colors, three bit planes, the same pixels
svg.desc: A six-pixel column with palette indices 1 through 6. Ordinary painting uses six color masks. OR encoding uses three masks selected by bits 1, 2 and 4. For pixel E, bits 1 and 4 reconstruct index 5, which selects the original purple palette entry.
svg.text: Numbers identify palette entries; they are not RGB values.
A filled cell paints that palette color.
A filled cell turns on that index bit.
3 Rebuild pixel E, then look up its color
Pattern counts exclude headers and other commands.
This does not mean the complete file is half the size.
